intro: Raleigh's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $103/month (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Raleigh metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $116, down 3.3% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $114. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $46 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$47.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $64 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$71. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $103 (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Raleigh metro non-climate asking rent $116, down 3.3% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Raleigh alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$114.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $137 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$149.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $164 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$207.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Bashford Ridge (~$75), Trinity Park (~$101), Village of Fox Run (~$103) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Woodcrest (~$359) is among the highest.
Raleigh has about 81 facilities and 7.4 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
